title: Atlético-GO vs. América-MG: Decisive Clash in Série B's 31st Round
seoTitle: Atlético-GO vs América-MG: Série B's 31st Round Decisive.
subtitle: 31st Round Match Pits Goian G-6 Team Against Coelho in Relegation Battle
excerpt: Atlético-GO hosts América-MG this Saturday at 4 PM for Série B's 31st round. Dragão aims to solidify its G-6 spot, while Coelho seeks to escape the relegation zone.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
Atlético-GO hosts América-MG this Saturday at 4 PM for Série B's 31st round. The confrontation is significant because Dragão is in the G-6, while Coelho is still fighting to escape the relegation zone.

Atlético-GO Enters G-6 and Aims to Consolidate Position

With a 1-0 victory over Goiás last weekend, Atlético-GO reached 49 points and returned to Série B's G-6. The Goian club has won five of its last seven fixtures and is five points behind second-placed Vila Nova, who currently occupy a direct promotion spot.

América-MG Fights to Escape Relegation Zone

América-MG occupies the penultimate position with 17 points, far from the first club outside the relegation zone, Botafogo-SP, which has 32 points. The team from Minas Gerais has lost its last three matches and still needs positive results to avoid relegation.

Atlético-GO Absences and Players on Yellow Cards

At right-back, Warley is in the medical department and will be replaced by Ewerthon. Goalkeeper Paulo Vítor, who had a disagreement with the president, has been confirmed as a starter. Among the players on yellow cards are Adriano Martins, Bruno José, Gustavo Coutinho, Natã Felipe, Junior Barreto, Tito, João Pedro, Cristiano, Daniel Peixoto, and Guilherme Lopes.

América-MG Absences and Players on Yellow Cards

Coelho will be without goalkeeper Bruno Brígido due to concussion protocol and midfielder Otávio, who is suspended for his third yellow card. There are also uncertainties regarding Ricardo Silva and Guilherme Parede. Among the players on yellow cards are Felipe Amaral, Eduardo Person, Gustavo, Manoel, Paulo Victor, Willian Bigode, and Jorge Jiménez.

Match Broadcast and Coverage

The match will be broadcast on ESPN (cable TV) and Disney+ (streaming). ge will provide live updates of all plays. The referee for the match will be Marianna Nanni Batalha, with assistants Raphael de Albuquerque Lima and Juliana Vicentin Esteves, and VAR Antonio Magno Lima Cordeiro.

With information from ge, Terra.
